style: アネの外見・衣装と人形の素材・造形は美術設定。給仕人形はitemを維持し、別人か未確定の工房職人は追加しない。潜水装備・浮力具・縄・食器・幻の食材・作業と破損の状態は共通立ち絵へ固定しない。

files.prompt_en: Create one full-length character illustration for a story-driven exploration game, painted with restrained brush texture, carefully shaded surfaces and a muted earthy palette. Center one figure within a vertical 1024 by 1536 canvas, facing slightly toward the viewer in a three-quarter pose, with head, hands and feet entirely visible and clear space around the silhouette. Soft diffuse light makes the face readable. The background is completely transparent with clean alpha edges, and the entire image contains only the figure. Both hands are empty. Depict Ane, an adult craftswoman who makes diving equipment. She has short dark chestnut hair tucked behind her ears, a sturdy practical build and a patient, attentive expression. She wears a muted indigo work jacket over a sand-coloured shirt, a narrow russet waist sash, dark olive trousers and worn leather boots. Her sleeves are rolled to the forearms. One hand is gently open at waist height while the other rests by her side.
files.prompt_ja: 物語中心の探索ゲーム用の全身人物画。控えめな筆の質感、丁寧な陰影、落ち着いた土の色を用いる。縦1024×1536の中央に一人を配置し、見る側へ少し向いた斜め正面の姿勢で、頭・両手・両足をすべて収め、輪郭の周囲に余白を取る。柔らかな拡散光で顔を見やすくする。背景は完全な透明で、きれいなアルファ輪郭とし、人物だけを描く。両手は空。潜水具職人アネを成人女性として描く。耳の後ろへ収めた短い暗い栗色の髪、実務的で丈夫な体格、辛抱強く注意深い表情。くすんだ藍色の作業上着、砂色のシャツ、細い赤茶色の腰帯、暗いオリーブ色のズボン、使い込んだ革靴。袖は前腕までまくる。片手を腰の高さで軽く開き、もう片方を体の横へ自然に下ろす。

files.prompt_en: Create one full-length character illustration for a story-driven exploration game, painted with restrained brush texture, carefully shaded surfaces and a muted earthy palette. Center one figure within a vertical 1024 by 1536 canvas, facing slightly toward the viewer in a three-quarter pose, with head, hands and feet entirely visible and clear space around the silhouette. Soft diffuse light makes the face readable. The background is completely transparent with clean alpha edges, and the entire image contains only the figure. Both hands are empty. Depict a human-sized serving automaton from an old inn. Its softly oval carved wooden face has small inset dark eyes and a simple closed mouth; the grain of aged pale wood is visible. Its head has a smooth wooden cap, and articulated wooden fingers, wrists and elbows have compact brass joints. It wears a faded warm grey long-sleeved tunic with a plain oatmeal linen apron, dark brown trousers and simple sturdy shoes. Its balanced upright stance and gently bent empty arms suggest a patient pause between serving tasks. The figure is intact, with subtle everyday surface wear and a calm neutral expression.
files.prompt_ja: 物語中心の探索ゲーム用の全身立ち絵。控えめな筆の質感、丁寧な陰影、落ち着いた土の色を用いる。縦1024×1536の中央に一体を配置し、見る側へ少し向いた斜め正面の姿勢で、頭・両手・両足をすべて収め、輪郭の周囲に余白を取る。柔らかな拡散光で顔を見やすくする。背景は完全な透明で、きれいなアルファ輪郭とし、人形だけを描く。両手は空。古い宿の人間ほどの大きさの給仕人形。柔らかな楕円の木彫りの顔に小さな暗いはめ込みの目と簡素な閉じた口があり、淡色の古い木目が見える。頭頂部は滑らかな木製の覆い。木製の指・手首・肘には小さな真鍮の関節がある。色あせた温かい灰色の長袖チュニック、生成りの簡素な麻の前掛け、暗褐色のズボン、丈夫で簡素な靴。均衡のとれた直立姿勢と軽く曲げた空の両腕で、給仕の合間に返事を待つ様子を表す。全体は壊れておらず、日常的な小さな使用感と穏やかで中立的な表情を備える。
